# Full Architecture Specification: @actdim/dynstruct-demo

## Architectural Invariants
1. Zero-FOUC Document Shell:
   Outer layout components (Layout.astro, Header.astro, Footer.astro) are implemented in native Astro with Tailwind CSS.
   Material UI and Emotion CSS-in-JS runtimes are strictly prohibited in the outer shell and must remain isolated inside client islands.

2. Island Isolation and Provider Boundaries:
   Astro mounts each React island in an independent React root (hydrateRoot).
   Every island requires PortalProvider (<ComponentContextProvider value={{ msgBus }}> and MUI <ThemeProvider>).
   React Context cannot cross island boundaries; cross-island communication must use the @actdim/msgmesh bus.

3. Declarative Message Broker (`def.msgBroker`):
   Dynstruct components register bus subscriptions (`subscribe`) and RPC handlers (`provide`) declaratively in ComponentDef.
   The runtime manages registration and release per mount automatically (StrictMode-safe).
   Manual bus subscriptions inside lifecycle hooks (`events.onReady` / `onDestroy`) are avoided.

4. Dogfooding Dynstruct Across Islands:
   All interactive islands (playground scenarios, cross-island filter and list, SSR catalog) are built as Dynstruct structs (`useComponent` + `toReact`) using @actdim/dynstruct-mui adapters.

5. MobX Reactivity Modes in Dynstruct:
   - prop({ reactive: true }): Deep reactivity; proxy recursively tracks all nested properties.
   - prop({ reactive: 'shallow' }): Shallow reactivity; array container mutations (push/pop) tracked, item internals untracked.
   - prop({ reactive: 'ref' }): Reference reactivity; reassignment tracked, internal mutation bypassed.

6. Astro SSG / SSR Semantics:
   By default, the demo builds with `output: 'static'`, pre-rendering all catalog pages at build time (SSG).
   The crawlable markup is immediately available to search bots without client JavaScript execution.
   Switching to on-demand server rendering requires setting `output: 'server'` with an Astro adapter.

## Message Mesh Channels

| Channel | Kind | Payload | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CATALOG.FILTER` | Pub/Sub | `{ query?: string, category?: string, minRating?: number }` | Published by `CatalogFilter` to filter items across islands; reset dispatches default filter payload |
| `NOTICE.TOAST` | Pub/Sub | `{ id: string, message: string, severity?: string, duration?: number }` | Dispatches toast alerts to the notification stack |
| `DIALOG.OPEN` | Pub/Sub | `{ dialogId: string, title: string, content: string }` | Opens modal dialog with contract-driven payload |
| `DRAWER.TOGGLE` | Pub/Sub | `{ open: boolean }` | Toggles or sets side drawer open state |
| `RPC.SEARCH` | Request/Response | In: `{ query: string }`, Out: `{ items: DemoCatalogItem[] }` | RPC search provider with debounce and latest-wins response matching |

## Core Code Examples

### 1. ComponentStruct Declaration
```typescript
import { ComponentStruct } from '@actdim/dynstruct/componentModel/contracts';
import { DemoMsgStruct } from '@/bus/portalMsgStruct';

export type CounterStruct = ComponentStruct<
  DemoMsgStruct,
  {
    props: {
      count: number;
      step: number;
      max: number;
    };
    actions: {
      increment: () => void;
      decrement: () => void;
      reset: () => void;
    };
  }
>;
```

### 2. ComponentDef Implementation with Declarative msgBroker
```typescript
export const useCounter = (params: ComponentParams<CounterStruct>) => {
  let c: Component<CounterStruct>;
  let m: ComponentModel<CounterStruct>;

  const def: ComponentDef<CounterStruct> = {
    regType: 'Counter',
    props: { count: 0, step: 1, max: 20 },
    actions: {
      increment: () => { if (m.count + m.step <= m.max) m.count += m.step; },
      decrement: () => { if (m.count - m.step >= 0) m.count -= m.step; },
      reset: () => { m.count = 0; },
    },
    view: () => (
      <Card>
        <Typography variant="h2">{m.count}</Typography>
        <Button label="+" onClick={m.increment} />
      </Card>
    ),
  };

  c = useComponent(def, params);
  m = c.model;
  return c;
};

export const Counter = toReact(useCounter);
```

### 3. Astro Island Integration
```astro
---
import Layout from '@/layouts/Layout.astro';
import { Counter } from '@/components/structs/counterStruct';
import { PortalProvider } from '@/components/common/PortalProvider';
---

<Layout title="Counter Island">
  <PortalProvider client:load>
    <Counter count={5} />
  </PortalProvider>
</Layout>
```
